coordinates: xnano and ynano; XY projection, nanometres, inclusive radius, same published frame
method: Each published frame-wise emitter coordinate is counted once. Two centers overlap when their XY separation is at most the stated radius. An emitter is isolated if it has zero such neighbors. Spatial-bin pairs and masks are compared to exhaustive pairwise distances in every frame. The first radius is the challenge in-focus PSF FWHM.
uniform_comparison: Per frame with n emitters, the homogeneous Poisson proxy gives a tagged emitter overlap probability of 1 - exp[-(n-1) pi r^2 / field_area]. The average weights each frame by n. Tubulin structure concentrates the emitters in a small part of the field.
interpretation: This verifies projected same-frame geometry on a simulated tubulin specimen. The photons, sensor noise and dye identity are not fitted. The difference from a homogeneous field quantifies the sensitivity to spatial clustering. Fixed-cell HaloTag dye rankings require their own matched measurements.
